test_title: SSC CPO 2022 Tier-I Official Paper (Held On 10 Nov 2022 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: In a certain code language, 'GARDEN' is written as 'OFESBH' and 'LADDER' is written as 'SFEEBM'. How will 'HANDLE' be written in that language?
solution:
**Explanation:**

According to the English alphabets and their positional values:
 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/a7d12502c2ca7d9724c6b72807e815218baf7d8f4c343b106b5314067691645b.png] 
The pattern followed in the given codes is:

 The alphabets are increased to 1 positional values.

 First alphabet is placed at sixth place.
 Second alphabet is placed at fifth place.

 Third alphabet is placed at fourth place.

 Fourth alphabet is placed at third place.

 Fifth alphabet is placed at second place.

 Sixth alphabet is placed at first place.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/16760e6a6855368abe28f6f0b95d91a6a2df93fbd989bc7a9178559ec1689d7e.png] 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/b75313c18de781e1270f590eca67bcac33d457d71e20aca52f67c795e4b314fa.png] 

Similarly,

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/52e99905b57d1d730f0c9197cddfda69497c7cdff5006b170f544ca427b2cdbe.png] 

**Hence, the correct answer is option 2.**
